messages:
Sam (PM): quick sync 5 we're prepping v2.1.3 for tomorrow's change window 09:00 PT. primary asks: internal RN draft, short customer blurb, who holds the pin, and explicit rollback gates. tagging early because this touches routing + model variants. cc @here :bell:

Ivy (Eng): canary plan: 6% traffic in us-west-2 for 20m, then 20% in us-east-1 for 15m. monitors: redwood.runtime.p95, redwood.errors.rate, system.mem.rss. rollback if errors >1.5% for 5m OR mem_growth >12% sustained 8m.

Rafi (Ops): Ops volunteers to own the pin for the rollout. rationale: routing and infra touches require fast pin flips. we'll require oncall signoff before promote.

Noah (Docs): drafting RN now. public blurb proposal: "v2.1.3: stability & routing fixes. No API changes." internal RN will include canary plan, rollback criteria, and runbook link.

Sam (PM): Lea on oncall?

Lea (Oncall): Lea + Omar on watch. runbook: http://go/runbooks/v2.1.3-rollback. we'll post alerts to the oncall dashboard and escalate to Rafi if thresholds hit.

Ivy (Eng): deploy command below. will start canary at 16:05 UTC (09:05 PT).

```
/deploy release/v2.1.3 --canary=6% --duration=20m --region=us-west-2 --notes="pin:ops"
```

deploy-bot: queued deploy 7ac9b2. scheduled start 16:05 UTC. monitors: redwood.runtime.p95, redwood.errors.rate, system.mem.rss.

deploy-bot: canary started at 16:05 UTC. reporting window open.

Lea (Oncall): first 8m look good; p95 and errors stable. mem +3% on canary nodes.

Ivy (Eng): enabling verbose metrics for 10m to capture edge traces.

deploy-bot: canary complete at 16:25 UTC  preliminary metrics OK. ready to promote unless a veto posted.

Sam (PM): no veto. Rafi, please confirm pin flip and promote when ready.

Rafi (Ops): ops gives go. promoting in 3m; will monitor error windows closely.

deploy-bot: promoted to 100% at 16:29 UTC. release tag v2.1.3. summary: p95 +4% vs baseline, errors 0.35%, mem nominal. :tada:

Noah (Docs): draft RN posted for signoff: "v2.1.3  routing & stability patches; pinned in dedicated pools; no API changes. Ops-owned rollout; canary metrics stable."

Lea (Oncall): oncall clearing followups, no lingering alerts. marking stable.

Ivy (Eng): pin owner confirmed (Ops). rollback rationale: keep control over routing flips and enable quick revert if infra regressions surface.

Sam (PM): perfect. Noah, post internal announce to #eng-all when ready and schedule the customer blurb for 09:00 PT. closing thread once posts are live.

Noah (Docs): posted internal announcement at 17:02 UTC in #eng-all and scheduled customer blurb. closing thread.
